archetypes.name: Shot-stopper
archetypes.desc: Wins points with saves: high save rate and goals prevented.

archetypes.name: Sweeper-keeper
archetypes.desc: Plays with the feet: lots of accurate passing and long distribution.

archetypes.name: Ball-playing defender
archetypes.desc: Starts attacks: passes, progressive passes and long balls.

archetypes.name: Stopper
archetypes.desc: Steps out and wins it: tackles, interceptions, and a few fouls.

archetypes.name: Aerial defender
archetypes.desc: Owns the box: headers won, clearances and blocks.

archetypes.name: Attacking full-back
archetypes.desc: A wide attacker from defence: crosses, dribbles, chances.

archetypes.name: Defensive full-back
archetypes.desc: Defender first: tackles, interceptions, clearances.

archetypes.name: Inverted full-back
archetypes.desc: Steps into midfield to pass: volume, accuracy, progression.

archetypes.name: Anchor
archetypes.desc: Screens the defence: reads play, intercepts, keeps it simple.

archetypes.name: Ball-winner
archetypes.desc: Wins the ball back in volume, and fouls when needed.

archetypes.name: Deep-lying playmaker
archetypes.desc: Dictates from deep: passing volume, long balls, progression.

archetypes.name: Box-to-box
archetypes.desc: Covers ground at both ends: tackles, box arrivals, shots, distance.

archetypes.name: Playmaker
archetypes.desc: The chance-maker: key passes, expected assists, final-third passes.

archetypes.name: Ball-carrier
archetypes.desc: Moves it by dribbling: take-ons and fouls drawn.

archetypes.name: Creative No.10
archetypes.desc: Makes chances: key passes, xA, big chances created.

archetypes.name: Shadow striker
archetypes.desc: Arrives to score: shots, xG and box touches.

archetypes.name: Touchline winger
archetypes.desc: Stays wide and delivers: crosses and chances.

archetypes.name: Inside forward
archetypes.desc: Cuts in to shoot: dribbles, shots, xG.

archetypes.name: Poacher
archetypes.desc: Lives in the box: chances, shots on target, little build-up.

archetypes.name: Target forward
archetypes.desc: Physical focal point: headers won and headed shots.

archetypes.name: Complete forward
archetypes.desc: Scores and creates: xG plus key passes and dribbles.

archetypes.name: Pressing forward
archetypes.desc: Works without the ball: tackles, interceptions, distance.

minutes_rule: 60% of the minutes the player's team could have played
